objective: Add the missing production composition/adapters for actual predecessor public APIs and make completed shutdown idempotent.
required_changes: Provide a production composition root in src/workbench/app/** that constructs LifecycleCoordinator adapters around the actual G4 backend/FrontendLease, G3BridgeServer.peer/request and TaskMailbox.deliver exact-session APIs, PersistentShell.snapshot/request_takeover/confirm_takeover/claim_manager controls, PauseCoordinator state/dispatch, WorkerReviewScheduler tick state, RecoveryCoordinator decisions, RawLogStore and MetadataAdmissionGate.

After shutdown is durably/locally confirmed complete, repeated shutdown calls must return/reobserve the terminal result without emitting new normal_stop/force/command actions. Incomplete shutdown may reobserve but must not blindly duplicate an already-issued stop for the same target/incarnation.

Add runtime composition tests that instantiate actual G3BridgeServer/TaskMailbox and PersistentShell/public Pause/Review/Recovery seams where practical, verify exact identities/no replay, and account for every thread/process/socket/temporary path.
Run lifecycle and changed-seam predecessor suites plus graphify update.
constraints: Do not modify predecessor packages to fit the coordinator; adapt only in CW15 scope. No fake-only production binding, real reboot, live external OMP mutation, tmux dependency, delegation, commit, publish, deploy or Docker.

report: Return candidate_ready/needs_reroute, concrete adapter/composition mapping to every predecessor API, shutdown idempotence evidence, per-acceptance runtime results, exact suites/residue, hashes/scope, and true environment-pending cases.
